blurb: Guests do a tandem skydive from about 12,000 to 13,000 feet with a certified instructor. The experience includes a safety briefing, gearing up, a scenic flight, freefall for 40-60 seconds, and a parachute ride over the Sonoran Desert. The center operates near Phoenix and Scottsdale, Arizona, with state-of-the-art equipment and top safety standards.
extraNote: Online booking fee $9.95 per person via Peek · Late check-in may delay skydive or forfeit deposit · Group organizer receives confirmation call 48 hours prior · I understand that my ticket is non-refundable for ANY reasons. · At the municipal airport in Casa Grande, AZ, about 30 minutes south of Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport on I-10 at Exit 185.

quotes.text: Ashlyn Tillman 6/22/2026 Truly can say this was one of the best things I have ever done. The pilot, instructors, and other staff made this entire experience fun, safe, and so enjoyable. I already can’t wait to do it again. Thank you guys for an unforgettable morning!!!
